title: Render the Queue paused notice as one compact line with its existing action
outcome: The Queue paused notice occupies one compact line while keeping the paused state readable and its existing action available.
acceptance: The Queue paused notice renders as one compact line, with a readable paused-state label and the existing action available on the same line.
Long supporting text does not turn the notice into a tall card; any necessary full explanation remains accessible, and the action remains usable by keyboard and assistive technology.
The change preserves queue pause and resume behavior and the existing available action; behavior tests cover the compact rendering and action without testing repository source text.
